name: Kalian
source:
Kalian is a strong and brave soldier. He tends to be quite impulsive with his actions and hides his feelings behind a very outgoing and flirty attitude. Despite that, he deeply cares about the people around him and wouldn't think twice about putting himself in danger to protect others.

[From [url=https://lyria-ghostkitty.itch.io/my-path]itch.io[/url]]
